column1: # Template for the next allocation (scripts/campaign.sh replaces {R}). Plan (10-20 15:00, user): back to SPF + early (best: a1-spf C176
# = 35,377), config/stage-b4-spf.sh. Two C176 rounds warm decode up (cold / warm decode profiles for the drift study), the second one is
# the warm baseline; then router R4 (new-session placement by prefill work) at C176. SPF aging and the correctness gate come after.
run start_profile_round.sh ROUND={R} VARIANT={R}-spf CONC=176 DELAY=900
run start_profile_round.sh ROUND={R} VARIANT={R}-spf2 CONC=176 DELAY=900
run start_profile_round.sh ROUND={R} VARIANT={R}-r4 CONC=176 DELAY=900
